notes: Session 8c: Batch 2 NN layer tests all pass (46/46), CrashTest SIGSEGV fix verified (4/4 pass). Root cause: BlasBufferUtil.getBlasStride() returned stride(-1) for 2D non-contiguous TAD views — e.g. stride(1)=1024 for f-order [128,64] TAD from [8,128,64] parent. BLAS Level 1 ops (dot, nrm2, asum, etc.) used this as incX, causing massive OOB reads → SIGSEGV in MKL. Fix: added ensureBlasLevel1Safe() that dups non-contiguous rank-2+ arrays before BLAS calls, and getBlasStride() returns 1 for non-vector arrays (after ensureBlasLevel1Safe guarantees contiguity).

fixes.description: Added ensureBlasLevel1Safe() method that dups non-contiguous rank-2+ arrays to contiguous 'c' order. Updated getBlasStride() to return 1 for non-vector arrays (after ensureBlasLevel1Safe guarantees contiguity).
Added ensureBlasLevel1Safe() calls to all Level 1 BLAS methods: dot, nrm2, asum, iamax, swap, copy, axpy, rot, scal. Prevents SIGSEGV on non-contiguous views passed to MKL/OpenBLAS.
